mapper.select: select ti.id track_id, ti.track_title, ti.order_num, ti.media_duration, ti.create_time, max(if(stat_type = '0701', stat_num, 0)) playStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0702', stat_num, 0)) praiseStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0703', stat_num, 0)) collectStatNum, max(if(stat_type = '0704', stat_num, 0)) commentStatNum from track_info ti inner join track_stat stat on stat.track_id = ti.id and stat.is_deleted = 0 where ti.album_id = #{albumId} and ti.status = '0501' and ti.is_deleted = 0 group by ti.id order by ti.order_num
